title: Variable Attenuator
text: Model variable attenuator, 1 input; {Minimum attenuation (dB)} sets the lowest value for insertion loss, {Maximum attenuation (dB)} sets the highest value of insertion loss, {Input impedance (Ohm)}, {Output impedance (Ohm)}, {Simulate noise} sets the simulate thermal noise and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Minimum attenuation (dB)
params.values: Lowest value for insertion loss or attenuation 0.001 (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum attenuation (dB)
params.values: Highest value of insertion loss or attenuation 1000 (default) | scalar

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
